name: kettlebell press up
description: A push-up with one hand on a kettlebell handle and the other on the floor, adding an uneven support and grip challenge.
instructions: Set one stable kettlebell on the floor and grip its handle with one hand; place the other hand on the floor.
Step back into a plank and keep your hips level.
Lower your chest between your hands with your elbows at a comfortable angle.
Press back up, finish the set, then switch the kettlebell to the other side.
